title: Move the pivot
description: Nine origin positions change how the same sheet rotates through space.
useCase: Choosing a meaningful pivot for a rotating component or layered animation.
interaction: Choose a pivot and rotate the sheet
reducedMotion: Changes settle immediately; keyboard activation is immediate.
limitations: Nine preset anchors and one rotation, not a freeform transform gizmo.
look: Pale blue-grey canvas with a blue gradient notebook card over a dashed outline, an orange pivot pin, a white nine-dot grid and a pill button.
motion: A toggle rotates the sheet −20° or back around the selected anchor over 400 ms, ease-out; picking another anchor moves the pin and re-pivots the sheet instantly.
adapt: The sheet's inline `transformOrigin` is derived from the `origin` index (`x`, `y` in 50% steps) and `turned` toggles a −20° rotate; easing lives in `sf-pivot-sheet` as `transition:transform 400ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`. Replace the notebook sheet with your element.
